# DisplayModeWidth <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DisplayModeWidth:Int32 display:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | In | Int32 | required | The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays). |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | The mode number, from 1 to [CountDisplayModes](CountDisplayModes). |

**Returns:** The width, or 0 if the display or mode does not exist.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The width in pixels of a mode from the list of a display. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.

## Differences

* A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).
